block.redstoneplus.tnter.desc: Spawns primed TNT in front on every redstone signal. Needs no TNT.
block.redstoneplus.freeze_tnter.desc: Spawns frozen TNT: it never explodes and does not move, except by pistons and water.
block.redstoneplus.activator_net.desc: Frozen TNT passing through becomes normal primed TNT.
block.redstoneplus.entity_teleporter.des: Stores every non-player entity above it exactly as it is. Entities arriving at the same time form a group that a Remote Detonator releases together.
block.redstoneplus.nuclear_repeater.desc: Keeps the redstone dust connected to its output at full strength for up to 200 blocks.
block.redstoneplus.arrow_shooter.desc: Fill with arrows and Uranium Shards. Each signal fires 6 arrows at 100 blocks per tick, half a tick apart, for 1 shard.
block.redstoneplus.uranium_ore.desc: Found in end stone in the End.
block.redstoneplus.and_gate.desc: Output on when left AND right input are on.
block.redstoneplus.or_gate.desc: Output on when left OR right input is on.
block.redstoneplus.xor_gate.desc: Output on when exactly one side input is on.
block.redstoneplus.not_gate.desc: Inverts the signal from the back.
block.redstoneplus.nand_gate.desc: Output off only when both side inputs are on.
block.redstoneplus.nor_gate.desc: Output on only when both side inputs are off.
block.redstoneplus.xnor_gate.desc: Output on when both side inputs are equal.
block.redstoneplus.amplifier.desc: Any signal from the back comes out at strength 15.
block.redstoneplus.t_flip_flop.desc: Every pulse from the back toggles the output.
block.redstoneplus.rs_latch.desc: Left input sets, right input resets. Remembers its state.
block.redstoneplus.pulse_limiter.desc: Turns any signal into a short 2 tick pulse.
block.redstoneplus.pulse_extender.desc: Keeps the output on for 1-20 seconds after the input goes off. Right click to set.
block.redstoneplus.delay_block.desc: Repeater with 1-20 redstone ticks of delay. Right click to set.
block.redstoneplus.randomizer.desc: Every pulse from the back gives a random output.
block.redstoneplus.counter.desc: Counts pulses from the back (0-15), outputs the count as strength. Side input resets.
block.redstoneplus.sequencer.desc: Every pulse moves the output: left, front, right.
block.redstoneplus.redstone_crossing.des: Two lines cross without touching: back to front and left to right.
block.redstoneplus.clock.desc: Pulses on its own. 1-20 redstone ticks, right click to set. A signal from the back pauses it.
block.redstoneplus.variable_source.desc: Signal source with adjustable strength 1-15. Right click to set.
block.redstoneplus.reinforced_redstone_b: Redstone block that survives any explosion.
Sends its input on one of 16 channels. Right click to change channel.
block.redstoneplus.wireless_receiver.des: Outputs 15 while its channel is active. Right click to change channel.
block.redstoneplus.player_detector.desc: Outputs 15 while a player is within 8 blocks.
block.redstoneplus.mob_detector.desc: Outputs a signal while hostile mobs are within 8 blocks.
block.redstoneplus.laser_sensor.desc: Invisible beam up to 32 blocks. Outputs 15 while something crosses it.
block.redstoneplus.block_breaker.desc: Breaks the block in front on each pulse.
block.redstoneplus.block_placer.desc: Places blocks from its inventory in front on each pulse.
block.redstoneplus.lightning_caller.desc: Strikes lightning on the first block up to 64 blocks in front.
block.redstoneplus.launch_pad.desc: Throws everything on top high into the air on each pulse.
block.redstoneplus.fan.desc: Blows entities away, up to 8 blocks, while powered.
block.redstoneplus.item_magnet.desc: Pulls items within 10 blocks and puts them into a container below.
block.redstoneplus.fire_starter.desc: Lights a fire in front while powered.
block.redstoneplus.spike_block.desc: Hurts everything standing on it while powered.
block.redstoneplus.phantom_block.desc: Solid, but you can walk through it while powered.
block.redstoneplus.conveyor_belt.desc: Moves entities on top. A redstone signal stops it.
block.redstoneplus.tnt_cannon.desc: Launches primed TNT in an arc on each pulse. Needs no TNT.
block.redstoneplus.uranium_nuke.desc: Huge explosion after 8 seconds. Lit by redstone, fire or explosions.
block.redstoneplus.fireball_launcher.des: Shoots a ghast fireball on each pulse.
block.redstoneplus.crop_harvester.desc: Harvests and replants grown crops in a 5x5 area in front.
block.redstoneplus.signal_display.desc: Shows the incoming signal strength as a number.
block.redstoneplus.landmine.desc: Explodes when stepped on or powered. Sneak to walk over it.
block.redstoneplus.anti_gravity_field.de: Everything above it floats up while powered.
block.redstoneplus.edge_detector.desc: Short pulse on every change of the back input, on and off.
block.redstoneplus.analog_inverter.desc: Outputs 15 minus the strength coming in from the back.
block.redstoneplus.signal_adder.desc: Adds the strength from left and right (max 15).
block.redstoneplus.signal_subtractor.des: Back strength minus the strongest side input.
block.redstoneplus.item_detector.desc: Outputs the number of dropped items within 5 blocks.
block.redstoneplus.light_sensor.desc: Outputs the light level above it.
block.redstoneplus.block_detector.desc: Outputs 15 while there is a block in front of it.
block.redstoneplus.entity_counter.desc: Outputs the number of living entities within 8 blocks.
block.redstoneplus.ice_maker.desc: Freezes all water in a 5x5 area in front on each pulse.
block.redstoneplus.water_pump.desc: Removes water and lava in a 5x5x5 area in front on each pulse.
block.redstoneplus.firework_launcher.des: Launches a random firework on each pulse. Needs nothing.
block.redstoneplus.snowball_turret.desc: Fires a spread of 8 snowballs on each pulse.
block.redstoneplus.anvil_dropper.desc: Drops an anvil from 12 blocks above the spot 6 blocks in front.
block.redstoneplus.cluster_tnter.desc: Spawns 5 primed TNT spread out in front on each pulse.
block.redstoneplus.tnt_rain.desc: Lets 9 primed TNT rain down from 20 blocks above the area in front.
block.redstoneplus.block_swapper.desc: Swaps the block in front with the block behind on each pulse.
block.redstoneplus.heal_pad.desc: Heals everything standing on it while powered.
block.redstoneplus.speed_pad.desc: Gives speed to everything standing on it while powered.
item.redstoneplus.remote_detonator.desc: Sneak + right click an Entity Teleporter to link. Use: the next stored group appears 10 blocks above the block you look at. Breaks after one use.
item.redstoneplus.uranium_shard.desc: Energy for the Arrow Shooter. Mined from Uranium Ore in the End.
item.redstoneplus.enriched_uranium.desc: Crafting material for the strongest machines.
item.redstoneplus.redstone_circuit.desc: Crafting material for almost every RedstonePlus block.
item.redstoneplus.redstone_remote.desc: Use: 1 second pulse on its channel. Sneak + use: change channel.
item.redstoneplus.redstone_wrench.desc: Rotates blocks. Sneak to rotate backwards.
item.redstoneplus.multimeter.desc: Right click a block to see its redstone values.
item.redstoneplus.tnt_activator.desc: Use: turns all frozen TNT within 32 blocks into live TNT.
message.redstoneplus.not_linked: Not linked. Right click an Entity Teleporter first.
message.redstoneplus.teleporter_missing: The linked Entity Teleporter is gone.
message.redstoneplus.multimeter: Incoming: %s | Weak out: %s | Strong out: %s | Comparator: %s
block.redstoneplus.super_piston.desc: Pushes up to 50 blocks. Right click: set how far the arm goes (1-13 blocks).
block.redstoneplus.sticky_super_piston.d: Sticky Super Piston: pushes up to 50 blocks and pulls them back. Right click: range 1-13.
item.redstoneplus.drill.desc: Place it, right click to get in. W drives and bores a 5x5 tunnel, it turns where you look. Look down/up to dig down/up. Sneak to get out, hit it to pick it up.
item.redstoneplus.crystal_silk.desc: Dropped by Crystal Spiders. Craft into string.
item.redstoneplus.magma_bone.desc: Dropped by Magma Skeletons. Craft into Blaze Powder.
item.redstoneplus.charged_gunpowder.desc: Dropped by Redstone Creepers. Makes TNT with sand.
item.redstoneplus.ruby.desc: Ruby material for tools and armor.
item.redstoneplus.sapphire.desc: Sapphire material for tools and armor.
item.redstoneplus.raw_titanium.desc: Titanium material for tools and armor.
item.redstoneplus.titanium_ingot.desc: Titanium material for tools and armor.
item.redstoneplus.raw_cobalt.desc: Cobalt material for tools and armor.
item.redstoneplus.cobalt_ingot.desc: Cobalt material for tools and armor.
item.redstoneplus.raw_mythril.desc: Mythril material for tools and armor.
item.redstoneplus.mythril_ingot.desc: Mythril material for tools and armor.
item.redstoneplus.raw_voidium.desc: Voidium material for tools and armor.
item.redstoneplus.voidium_ingot.desc: Voidium material for tools and armor.
block.redstoneplus.ruby_ore.desc: Found everywhere below Y 64, lots in Redstone Fields.
block.redstoneplus.deepslate_ruby_ore.de: Found everywhere below Y 64, lots in Redstone Fields.
block.redstoneplus.sapphire_ore.desc: Found everywhere below Y 64, lots in Crystal Forests.
block.redstoneplus.deepslate_sapphire_or: Found everywhere below Y 64, lots in Crystal Forests.
block.redstoneplus.titanium_ore.desc: Found between Y -32 and 96, lots in Titan Highlands.
block.redstoneplus.deepslate_titanium_or: Found between Y -32 and 96, lots in Titan Highlands.
block.redstoneplus.void_crystal.desc: Glowing crystal from the Void Wastes and Crystal Spires.
block.redstoneplus.karst_limestone.desc: Pale rock of the Piston Karst.
block.redstoneplus.lichen_karst.desc: Karst limestone grown over with orange lichen.
block.redstoneplus.rusted_soil.desc: Iron-red ground of the Switchyard Flats.
block.redstoneplus.slag.desc: Leftovers of the realm's old smelters.
block.redstoneplus.resonant_crystal.desc: Glows and chimes deep in the Resonance Hollows.
block.redstoneplus.sulfur_crust.desc: Yellow crust of the Kiln Barrens.
block.redstoneplus.briar_thorns.desc: Slows and scratches whoever walks through it.
block.redstoneplus.tripper_rail.desc: Detector rail that also reacts to anything walking over it, not only minecarts.
block.redstoneplus.crusher.desc: Redstone signal: rams the two blocks in front of it. Touching crushers fire as a ripple. Jam it with a Piston Brace.
block.redstoneplus.hazard_switch.desc: Redstone signal: throws everything on the rails beside it off the track, towards its front. Burn it out with a Pulse Injector.
block.redstoneplus.lockdown_gate.desc: Open portcullis. Redstone signal: slams shut for 10 seconds and calls nearby Bell Stalkers. A Decoy Beacon keeps it open.
block.redstoneplus.floodgate.desc: Redstone signal: a surge sweeps everything within 6 blocks towards its front. Disarm it with a Repeater Wrench.
block.redstoneplus.kiln_turret.desc: Redstone signal: spits a fire charge. Rows fire as a volley. A held Signal Jammer stops it.
block.redstoneplus.volley_launcher.desc: Redstone signal: fires a fan of three arrows. Cut it loose with Insulated Cutters.
block.redstoneplus.decoy_beacon.desc: Chimes like footsteps: Bell Stalkers within 24 blocks go to it, Lockdown Gates within 16 blocks stay open.
item.redstoneplus.realm_cog.desc: Gear from a realm construct. Crafts the counter tools.
item.redstoneplus.piston_brace.desc: Right click a Crusher to jam it for good.
item.redstoneplus.pulse_injector.desc: Right click a Hazard Switch to burn it out. Right click a construct to short-circuit it for 5 seconds.
item.redstoneplus.repeater_wrench.desc: Right click a Floodgate to disarm it. Sneak + right click any realm trap to switch it between armed and safe.
item.redstoneplus.signal_jammer.desc: While you hold it, realm traps within 10 blocks and Kiln Brute volleys do not fire.
item.redstoneplus.insulated_cutters.desc: Shears that cut tripwire without setting it off, disarm Volley Launchers and hurt Spool Weavers badly.
message.redstoneplus.wrench_sneak: Sneak + right click to switch this trap between armed and safe.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.title: Redstone Realm Field Guide
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.0:
REDSTONE REALM
Field Guide

A world that runs on redstone. Every land has its own machines, creatures and traps. Nothing explains itself: watch the machines to see how they work.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.1:
GETTING THERE

Build a frame of redstone blocks like a Nether portal (inside at least 2 wide, 3 high) and light it with flint and steel. Step in. A portal waits on the other side to bring you back.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.2:
THE HISTORY I

This was the Engine World of the Wirewrights. One Great Bell, the Concordance, hung in a cradle at the heart of their Foundry City; every clock and machine kept time by its toll.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.3:
THE HISTORY II

To wake every engine at once the Council ordered the Overtoll. The cradle cracked, the cities answered, and on the last stroke the Bell tore free and rose into the sky.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.4:
THE HISTORY III

It hangs there still in place of the sun. When it tolls, the machines below lose a little more of their purpose. Etched Plates found in old chests tell the rest.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.5:
FOUNDRY CITIES

The ruined cities of the Wirewrights spread hundreds of blocks wide, behind broken walls. At the centre of each stands the empty cradle where a bell once hung.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.6:
PISTON KARST
Pale limestone towers.

Trigger: pressure plate
Response: crushing passage
Counter: Piston Brace (right click a Crusher)

The vault at the end opens with two levers and an AND gate.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.7:
SWITCHYARD FLATS
Rust, slag and rails.

Trigger: Tripper Rail
Response: hazard diversion into a spike pit
Counter: Pulse Injector (burns out a Hazard Switch, and stuns constructs).
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.8:
RESONANCE HOLLOWS
Crystal caves deep below.

Trigger: footstep vibration (sculk sensor)
Response: gate lockdown
Counter: Decoy Beacon

Sneak: the Bell Stalker hunts by sound.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.9:
SLUICE GARDENS
Canals and copper.

Trigger: bridge tripwire
Response: floodgate surge
Counter: Repeater Wrench

Sneak + right click with the wrench arms or disarms any trap.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.10:
KILN BARRENS
Black rock and fire.

Trigger: pressure plate
Response: fire-charge volley
Counter: Signal Jammer (hold it: traps within 10 blocks stay quiet).
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.11:
TRIPWIRE BRIAR
Thorns and rusted towers.

Trigger: tripwire
Response: arrow volley
Counter: Insulated Cutters (cut wire safely, disarm launchers).
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.12:
THE CONSTRUCTS
Karst Colossus: slams the ground.
Switchback Crawler: charges, fast on rails.
Bell Stalker: blind, tolls.
Sluice Chainjaw: drags you in.
Kiln Brute: fire volleys.
Spool Weaver: roots you with wire.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.13:
THE MACHINE-BOUND
Leaking Cell, Detonator Husk, Tripwire Brood, Kilnbound, Living Capacitor, Relay Strider, Bellows Hog and Flesh Press: creatures rebuilt by the realm's machines. Watch their tricks.
item.redstoneplus.guide_book.desc: Right click to read: every item, block, creature and biome of RedstonePlus explained.
guide.redstoneplus.title: RedstonePlus Guide
guide.redstoneplus.cover:
Everything this mod adds, explained. The next page lists the chapters: click one to jump there.

All blocks and items are in the RedstonePlus and Redstone Realm creative tabs. Their tooltips say the same as this book.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.core.intro: The items RedstonePlus started with: TNT machines, frozen TNT, the Entity Teleporter with its Remote Detonator, the Nuclear Repeater, the ArrowShooter and uranium.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.logic.intro: Flat like a repeater. They output towards the way you looked when placing them. Two-input gates read left and right, the rest read the back. Right click adjustable ones; sneak to count down.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.sources.intro: Blocks that give a signal, and wireless: a transmitter powers every receiver on the same channel (16 channels, even across dimensions). Right click to change the channel.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.sensors.intro: Sensors watch something and send a redstone signal to every side while it is true. Combine them with gates and lamps.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.machines.intr: Machines act on a redstone signal. Most face the way they point when placed (like a dispenser).
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.display.intro: Show what your circuits are doing, or surprise whoever walks by.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.tools.intro: Helpers for building and testing circuits, the Super Piston that pushes up to 50 blocks, and the Drill you can ride through rock.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.ores.intro: Six ores: Ruby, Sapphire, Titanium, Cobalt, Mythril (deep down) and Voidium (in the End). Each makes storage blocks, five tools and full armor. Uranium makes tools and armor too.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.extras.intro: Building blocks, what the new mobs drop, and food.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.world.intro: New creatures of the Overworld and the End, and the biomes they live in. The Overworld biomes need TerraBlender.
guide.redstoneplus.chapter.realm.intro: A dimension of machines. Build a frame of redstone blocks like a Nether portal and light it with flint and steel. It is the ruin of a world that once ran on redstone: glowing veins run through every biome, old roads cross it with lamps that still burn where power remains, and its great buildings (generator halls, relay spires, circuit temples) stand either humming or in ruins. The pages after this are the realm's own field guide, then its blocks, tools, creatures and biomes.
entity.redstoneplus.uranium_zombie.desc: Glowing zombie that never burns in daylight. Its hits poison. Drops Uranium Flesh.
entity.redstoneplus.redstone_creeper.des: Red creeper with twice the blast. Drops Charged Gunpowder. Lives in the Redstone Fields.
entity.redstoneplus.crystal_spider.desc: Fast cyan spider that slows what it bites. Drops Crystal Silk.
entity.redstoneplus.magma_skeleton.desc: Fire proof skeleton whose arrows set you on fire. Drops Magma Bones.
entity.redstoneplus.ruby_slime.desc: Red slime that sometimes drops rubies.
entity.redstoneplus.void_enderman.desc: Purple enderman of the new End biomes: stronger, and it attacks on sight. Drops Void Pearls.
entity.redstoneplus.ember_pig.desc: Fire proof orange pig. Drops Ember Pork.
entity.redstoneplus.redstone_golem.desc: Red iron golem that guards the Redstone Fields. Drops redstone and rubies.
entity.redstoneplus.karst_colossus.desc: Piston Karst. Walking stone engine: its punches launch you, and its ground slam sets off every realm trap nearby. Left alone it walks to crushers and stamps them into motion.
entity.redstoneplus.switchback_crawler.d: Switchyard Flats. Rail centipede: twice as fast on rails, charges in straight lines and drags minecarts along. It patrols the tracks, screeching along the rails.
entity.redstoneplus.bell_stalker.desc: Resonance Hollows. Blind: it hunts by footsteps, so sneak. Its toll blinds you and trips sculk sensors. A Decoy Beacon lures it away. It seeks out bells and rings them.
entity.redstoneplus.sluice_chainjaw.desc: Sluice Gardens. Chained copper gator: its bite drags you in, in water it whips up a whirlpool. It works the floodgates, making them surge.
entity.redstoneplus.kiln_brute.desc: Kiln Barrens. Walking furnace: burning punches, fire-charge volleys (a Signal Jammer stops them), and it smelts items dropped near it. It stokes campfires and magma back to life.
entity.redstoneplus.spool_weaver.desc: Tripwire Briar. Wall-climbing spider that lashes wire to root you. Insulated Cutters hurt it badly; shear it for string. It strings webs around the lamp posts.
entity.redstoneplus.leaking_cell.desc: Zombie in a leaking uranium cage. Poisons, spills toxic puddles when hurt, and the spill makes crops grow. It drinks from exposed redstone veins to heal.
entity.redstoneplus.detonator_husk.desc: Creeper wired to a detonator: when one is about to blow, every Husk nearby starts its fuse, and the blast sets off realm traps. It feeds on the power of redstone blocks.
entity.redstoneplus.tripwire_brood.desc: Spider with a crystal egg sack. Its bite roots you in place; when it dies, cave spiders burst out. It webs up tripwires and thorn thickets.
entity.redstoneplus.kilnbound.desc: Skeleton in a furnace frame. Fire proof, burning arrows, and every shot fires the Kiln Turrets around it. It tends the Kiln Turrets and the fires near them.
entity.redstoneplus.living_capacitor.des: Slime in a capacitor frame. Every hit it takes discharges a shock into everything close and sets off traps. It arcs power into dead lamps nearby and brings them back on.
entity.redstoneplus.relay_strider.desc: Enderman strung with relay cables: hostile on sight, and its hits can relay you a few blocks away. It climbs to lightning rods and charges the air.
entity.redstoneplus.bellows_hog.desc: Pig with bellows: when hurt it blasts hot air. Feed it coal and for a minute it smelts items dropped around it. It blows campfires back into flame.
entity.redstoneplus.flesh_press.desc: Golem made of a flesh press. Crushing blows. Give it a redstone block and it becomes your guardian. It presses the rubble of ruins back into bricks.
biome.redstoneplus.redstone_fields.desc: Overworld. Red grass and redstone boulders, lots of rubies. Redstone Creepers and Golems.
biome.redstoneplus.crystal_forest.desc: Overworld. Turquoise forest with amethyst crystals and lots of sapphire. Crystal Spiders.
biome.redstoneplus.titan_highlands.desc: Overworld. Grey hills with titanium rocks and lots of titanium ore.
biome.redstoneplus.void_wastes.desc: End. Void Stone ground with void crystals. Void Endermen.
biome.redstoneplus.piston_karst.desc: Realm. Pale limestone towers. Crusher passages with an AND-gate vault. Karst Colossus.
biome.redstoneplus.switchyard_flats.desc: Realm. Rust and slag crossed by long tracks with powered rails and signal posts. Junctions with a Tripper Rail and a spike pit. Switchback Crawler.
biome.redstoneplus.resonance_hollows.des: Realm, underground. Crystal caves. Gatehouses with sculk sensors and Lockdown Gates. Bell Stalker.
biome.redstoneplus.sluice_gardens.desc: Realm. Canals and copper, also the realm's seas. Tripwire bridges over floodgates. Sluice Chainjaw.
biome.redstoneplus.kiln_barrens.desc: Realm. Black rock, sulfur and lava. Bridges between walls of Kiln Turrets. Kiln Brute.
biome.redstoneplus.tripwire_briar.desc: Realm. Thorns and rusted towers. Ambush paths with arrow launchers and a laser watch post. Spool Weaver.
block.redstoneplus.realmstone.desc: The rock the Redstone Realm is made of.
block.redstoneplus.realmstone_bricks.des: Building block of the realm's old builders.
block.redstoneplus.hematite.desc: Banded red rock of the Hematite Scarps.
block.redstoneplus.dark_hematite.desc: The dark bands of the scarps.
block.redstoneplus.cinder_rock.desc: Black rock of the Kiln Barrens.
block.redstoneplus.tempest_basalt.desc: Glassy black stone of the Tempest Shoals.
block.redstoneplus.frost_realmstone.desc: Frozen rock of the Frostwork Wastes. Slippery.
block.redstoneplus.fossil_circuit.desc: Ancient circuits turned to stone. Glows faintly.
block.redstoneplus.redstone_vein.desc: Glowing redstone grown through the rock.
block.redstoneplus.salt_crust.desc: White crust of the Oxide Salt Flats.
block.redstoneplus.rust_plating.desc: Rusted plates from the realm's derelict machines.
block.redstoneplus.shell_plating.desc: Plating of the great shell casings in the dunes.
block.redstoneplus.rust_sand.desc: Red sand of the Arsenal Dunes. Falls like sand.
block.redstoneplus.red_clay.desc: Clay of the Red Clay Fen.
block.redstoneplus.canal_moss.desc: Teal moss of the Sluice Gardens.
block.redstoneplus.briar_soil.desc: Root-tangled ground of the Tripwire Briar.
block.redstoneplus.heather_turf.desc: Crimson heather of the Landmark Moors.
block.redstoneplus.root_soil.desc: Dark soil of the Vein Mire, threaded with glowing roots.
block.redstoneplus.grove_moss.desc: Deep teal moss of the Lamplit Grove.
block.redstoneplus.pale_root_log.desc: Wood of the giant trees of the Lamplit Grove.
block.redstoneplus.vein_log.desc: Pale root with glowing red veins.
block.redstoneplus.fen_reed.desc: Dark red reeds of the fens.
block.redstoneplus.red_coral_shrub.desc: Stone coral that grows on dry land in the realm. Glows a little.
block.redstoneplus.pale_stalk.desc: Glowing pale stalks of the Vein Mire.
block.redstoneplus.salt_brush.desc: Dry brush of the salt flats.
block.redstoneplus.cinder_bloom.desc: A flower that grows from hot cinders. Glows.
block.redstoneplus.redstone_cluster.desc: Glowing crystal of pure redstone. Breaks into redstone dust.
block.redstoneplus.realm_redstone_ore.de: Found in the realm's rock. Drops the same as its Overworld ore.
block.redstoneplus.realm_iron_ore.desc: Found in the realm's rock. Drops the same as its Overworld ore.
block.redstoneplus.realm_copper_ore.desc: Found in the realm's rock. Drops the same as its Overworld ore.
biome.redstoneplus.arsenal_dunes.desc: Realm. Red dunes with crashed shell casings, derelict pylons and a minecart loop that never stops.
biome.redstoneplus.rubedo_gardens.desc: Realm. Terraces of redstone crystal, red pools and glass domes over growing crystals.
biome.redstoneplus.landmark_moors.desc: Realm. Crimson heather, ruined walls, split monoliths and bell towers that toll by themselves.
biome.redstoneplus.red_clay_fen.desc: Realm. Red water and clay, reeds, boardwalks and brick kilns that never go out.
biome.redstoneplus.hematite_scarps.desc: Realm. Banded red cliffs and hoodoos, stamping crusher mills and caged beasts.
biome.redstoneplus.tempest_shoals.desc: Realm. A teal sea between black basalt pillars; storm spires call down lightning.
biome.redstoneplus.frostwork_wastes.desc: Realm. Snow and ice over rails, frozen spires and leaning derelict towers.
biome.redstoneplus.vein_mire.desc: Realm. A dark fen threaded with glowing red roots and pale stalks.
biome.redstoneplus.oxide_salt_flats.desc: Realm. White salt with glowing red cracks, scrap heaps and old track.
biome.redstoneplus.lamplit_grove.desc: Realm. Giant pale-root trees with lamps hanging on chains under a violet sky.
biome.redstoneplus.circuit_fossil_beds.d: Realm, underground. Caves of fossil circuits, glowing redstone veins and crystal clusters.
entity.redstoneplus.spark_mite.desc: Everywhere. Copper beetle that grazes on glowing redstone veins in herds and flees from jackals and players.
entity.redstoneplus.lamp_moth.desc: Everywhere. Foil moth drawn to anything still giving light: flocks circle the lit lamps of the old roads and ruins.
entity.redstoneplus.scrap_jackal.desc: Everywhere. Pack hunter of scrap metal: it chases Spark Mites and Lamp Moths and digs through ruin rubble for iron, redstone and cogs. It leaves you alone unless you hurt the pack.
block.redstoneplus.cracked_realmstone_br: Bricks split by the Last Toll.
block.redstoneplus.chiseled_realmstone_b: Carved with the circuit sigils of the Wirewrights. The lines still glow.
block.redstoneplus.bell_bronze.desc: Metal of the Great Bell. Shards of it rained down across the realm when it tore free.
block.redstoneplus.wirewright_tiles.desc: Floor tiles of the Wirewrights' halls.
item.redstoneplus.etched_plate_1.desc: "We hung the Great Bell in its cradle at the heart of the Foundry City. Every clock in the realm kept time by its toll, and every machine moved as one."
item.redstoneplus.etched_plate_2.desc: "Power ran beneath every road and every wall. Where the veins glow in the ground, the old grid is still bleeding."
item.redstoneplus.etched_plate_3.desc: "We built the constructs to tend the machines while we slept. Nobody ever told them to stop."
item.redstoneplus.etched_plate_4.desc: "The Council ordered one great toll to wake every engine at once. The cradle cracked on the first stroke. On the second the cities answered."
item.redstoneplus.etched_plate_5.desc: "On the last stroke the Bell tore free and rose into the sky. It hangs there still in place of the sun, and every time it tolls the machines forget a little more."
item.redstoneplus.etched_plate_6.desc: "Those who stayed too close to the leaking engines became part of them. We call them Machine-Bound now. Do not call them by their old names."
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.14:
BUILD YOUR OWN
Traps are normal redstone parts: any signal fires them, and touching traps of the same kind fire one after another. Mix them with gates, sensors and wireless from RedstonePlus.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.15:
EXAMPLE
Laser Sensor across a door -> Delay -> row of Kiln Turrets.
Player Detector -> Counter -> Signal Display shows visitors.
Clock -> Sequencer -> three Floodgates = a wave pool.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.16:
CREATURE JOBS 1
Colossus: its slam sets off every trap nearby.
Crawler: drags minecarts, fast on rails.
Bell Stalker: its toll trips sculk sensors.
Chainjaw: whirlpool in water.
Kiln Brute: smelts items dropped near it.
Spool Weaver: shear it for string.
book.redstoneplus.realm_guide.17:
CREATURE JOBS 2
Leaking Cell: its spill makes crops grow.
Detonator Husk: its blast fires traps.
Brood: bursts into cave spiders.
Kilnbound: fires the Kiln Turrets.
Capacitor: shocks traps.
Bellows Hog: feed coal, it smelts.
Flesh Press: give a redstone block, it guards you.
